Name: Arrbyte's Zebrafinches
Author: Arrbyte
Description:
[b][img]https://piskel-imgstore-b.appspot.com/img/cd405ef5-1da2-11ef-90de-9f540fb20209.gif[/img]﻿[/b]

[b]Content[/b]
This adds Zebrafinches to marine's shop. Lays unique eggs and collects nesting material... as they always do. You can sell it or recycle it.

[b]Available in
[/b]- English
- German
- French by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163/about-me?gameId=1303]vin163[/url].

[b]Origin
[/b]As always: The sound is recorded myself. The birds and chirps you hear are from my male birds, as well are the color schemes inspired by them.
Thanks to Mad Denim for the pixelart! 

[font=Arial][size=5][b]Colors to collect:[/b]
[/size][size=3]- Grey
- White
- Brown
- Yellowish

Specials (not in shop):
- Gold[/size][/font][size=3]
[/size]
